name: dsh-quote-archive
description: Archive, search, and recall group-chat quotes locally, with an agent-callable quote tool and a full AstrBot-style management page (library, statistics with emoji-reaction and reply-comment charts, insights with a real yearly report and generated SVG poster, trash, people with learned nicknames/aliases, collections, and collaboration) whose entire API surface is served by a local compatibility layer, including a zero-dependency local BM25 semantic search index (no embedding model required). Outbound delivery runs through a small transport layer: the OneBot v11 gateway by default, with an optional dsh-im bridge fallback when that plugin is installed (never a hard dependency). Needs Node.js 22.13+; QQ capture and reposting are optional and require a running SnowLuma / OneBot v11 gateway, whose HTTP address, forward WebSocket address and access tokens the plugin finds automatically in local SnowLuma and qq-bridge config files.
